name: headless-app-tanstack
title: Headless App for TanStack Start
description: Give your agents a backend: sign-in, OAuth consent, an MCP server, and a page to connect and revoke agents.
docs: Set `site_url` in `supabase/config.toml` to the origin serving your app, and `PRODUCT_NAME` in `routes/_protected/agents.tsx`. Run `supabase config push` and `supabase functions deploy mcp-server`, then sign in and open `/agents` to connect an agent. Add tools in `supabase/functions/mcp-server/tools/`.
